releaseNotes:
NChat 1.0.76 repairs friendships and adds Unfriend.

Some older conversations lost their friendship record while the chat stayed on screen, and messages to them could not be sent anymore. This version shows the correct Add button for those people so you can reconnect with one tap, and it adds an Unfriend option in two places: on the Friends list (the person-remove icon on the right of each row) and in a person's profile menu (top-right, beside Block).

Blocking someone now also ends the friendship on the server, so a blocked-then-unblocked pair can become friends again instead of being stuck.

Messages, photos, voice notes and calls are otherwise unchanged. Package identity and the verified signing key are unchanged.
